stayType: Restaurant and bar with rooms at Hynish, Tiree
accommodation: Five rooms and a family suite, offered at bed and breakfast rates
suitableFor: Couples, families and small groups wanting a base on the quiet south end of Tiree with a restaurant on site

confirmedFeatures: Restaurant and lounge bar on site, local crab, lobster, lamb and beef on the menu, family-run, large range of Scottish whiskies, beers and ciders
overview: Alan Stevenson House is a family-run restaurant and bar with five rooms and a family suite in the Hynish heritage site on the Isle of Tiree. Hynish was the base for building the Skerryvore lighthouse. Dinner is served Monday to Saturday and there is a Sunday roast, with booking advised.
surfTripFit: A practical base with an evening meal on site, handy for a surf trip to Tiree where the west-facing beaches are a drive across the island.
gaps: Distance to Balevullin, parking, dog policy and board or wetsuit storage not stated.
